initial_plan.answerable_part: The file records crash dates, so it can show how the counts of police-reported crashes are distributed by weekday over 2013 through 2025.
initial_plan.denominator: None; report the count for each weekday
initial_plan.population: All police-reported crash rows with a nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
initial_plan.grouping: Day of week of crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check_interpretation.population_and_coverage: The plan population is 2,132,218 crash rows. Every year from 2013 through 2025 has observations from January 1 to December 31 and at least one row on each of its 365 or 366 calendar dates, so no partial year or uncovered date within the requested period was found.
data_check_interpretation.value_quality: Among the 2,132,218 population rows (100%), 0 have a missing crash_date, 0 have an impossible/unparseable or blank/unknown-string date, and 0 have one of the checked common sentinel dates. crash_date is a typed DATE; missing dates cannot be assigned a weekday and are outside the population definition.
data_check_interpretation.decision: Keep every row with a typed crash_date in 2013-2025 and group it by weekday. The check found no in-scope rows that need exclusion or a special unknown-date group; disclose that the data covers police-reported records, not crash risk adjusted for exposure.
data_check_interpretation.changed: No change to the initial plan.

final_plan.answerable_part: The file supports a distribution of the number of police-reported crash records across weekdays for the full 2013-2025 calendar period.
final_plan.denominator: None; absolute crash-record count for each weekday
final_plan.population: All police-reported crash rows with a typed crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive (2,132,218 rows)
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; each year has observed crash records on every calendar date
final_plan.grouping: Day of week of crash_date, Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: Counts describe police-reported crash records, not crash probability or risk per day, person, trip, or amount of traffic; they pool all years and cannot explain causes of weekday differences. The data check found 0 missing/invalid dates among 2,132,218 in-scope rows and crash records on all calendar dates in each year.
